Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football GPL 2026/27: Berekum Chelsea beat Young Apsotles to move up on league table Source : Lawrence Degraft Baidoo 22 November 2026 5:04pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Berekum Chelsea bounced back to winning ways in the Ghana Premier League following their 2-1 victory over Young Apostles on Sunday afternoon.
The Berekum-based side claimed all three points on matchday 12 to move up thhe league table.
Chelsea came into the weekend in 10th position after picking up 15 points from their opening 11 games of the Premier League campaign, while Young Apostles had managed eight from the same period and were languishing in the 18th position on the league log.
It was more of a precautionary start for the two teams, as neither Chelsea nor Apostles wanted to leave spaces in behind their defence, keeping a cagey contest for the opening 30 minutes.
However, the home side found a way to unsettle the visitors.
Seidu Abubakari shot Chelsea into the lead after 34 minutes, breaking the deadlock to put them ahead against Young Apostles.
Six minutes into the second half, Jonah Attuquaye doubled the lead, putting the game beyond the reach of the visitors.
Despite conceding two goals, Young Apostles continued to search for a way back into the game and found one through Samuel Prempeh, who scored in the 67th minute to reduce the deficit.
The result lifts Chelsea three places to seventh in the league table after Basake Holy Stars, Swedru All Blacks and Aduana Football Club all failed to pick up maximum points.
